title: Lithuanian customs confirms unauthorised access to its BAP user portal, partly restores services
what_changed: Status changed from developing to confirmed: The Record (16 Nov) relays the agency's statement confirming unauthorised access to BAP. Added the affected login window (9-10 November), the partial restoration on 16 November and chief Vygantas Paigozinas's description of the attack. Sources LRT/BNS and The Record were added, and validation is now corroborated.
